meta.title: Help - frequently asked questions
meta.description: Have questions or need help? Check out the frequently asked questions or contact our support team. We're here to help you!

moreQuestions.title: Have more questions?
moreQuestions.subtitle: Describe your case to get the most accurate assistance.

content.question: How do I create an account?
content.answer: To create an account, click the 'Try for free' button on the homepage. You can register using your email address or sign in with Google, Facebook, or GitHub.

content.question: Do I need to activate my account after registration?
content.answer: Yes, if you register using your email, you'll receive a message with an activation link. Click it to activate your account and gain access to the platform.

content.question: What are the password requirements?
content.answer: Your password must be at least 8 characters long, including one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one special character (e.g., !, @, #).

content.question: How can I change my password?
content.answer: If you log in with email and password, you can change your password in the 'Account settings' → 'Manage account' section.

content.question: I forgot my password – what should I do?
content.answer: On the login page, click 'Forgot password?'. Enter your email address, and you'll receive a message with a link to reset your password.

content.question: How do I change my personal information?
content.answer: Log in and go to 'Account settings' → 'Personal information' to edit your first name, last name, or other profile details.

content.question: Where can I check or change my plan?
content.answer: Log in and go to 'Account settings' → 'Subscription' to view your current plan and switch to another.

content.question: Where can I download my invoices?
content.answer: Log in and go to 'Account Settings' → 'Invoices'. Here you can view your payment history and download PDF invoices for all your subscriptions.

content.question: How do I delete my account?
content.answer: Log in and go to 'Account settings' → 'Manage account'. You'll find the option to delete your account there.

content.question: How do projects work on the platform?
content.answer: Projects consist of interactive stages that you can complete at your own pace. They are not live classes – you work whenever it suits you.

content.question: Which plans include access to projects?
content.answer: Each project is assigned to specific plans – for example, some are available only in the Basic and Premium plans. Access to a project depends on your active plan.

content.question: Do projects have their own community channels?
content.answer: Yes. Each project has a dedicated channel for Basic and Premium users, where you can chat with other participants, share posts, and exchange experiences.

content.question: Can I book a 1:1 consultation with a mentor?
content.answer: Yes. Premium users can request an individual 1:1 consultation with a mentor to get help, review code, or discuss any questions related to the project. Each consultation lasts 30 minutes.

content.question: Do I need to install additional software?
content.answer: Yes. You’ll be coding projects on your own computer, so you’ll need a code editor (e.g., VS Code) and any tools required for the project’s specific technology.

content.question: Can I pause a project and return to it later?
content.answer: Yes. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can return to the project at any time.

content.question: Will I receive a certificate after completing a project?
content.answer: Yes. After completing a project in the Basic or Premium plan, you’ll receive a certificate that you can download or share.

content.question: Is access to projects time-limited?
content.answer: No. Once you purchase access, you’ll have unlimited, lifetime access to the project materials within your plan.

content.question: Can I use the projects on my phone?
content.answer: Yes, our platform also works on mobile devices. However, for the best experience, we recommend using a computer.

content.question: Will I receive a certificate after completing a project?
content.answer: Yes, after completing a project on the Basic or Premium plan, you'll get a personalized certificate in PDF or PNG format.

content.question: Is the certificate available immediately after completing the project?
content.answer: Yes, the certificate is generated automatically after finishing all stages. You can download it directly from the platform.

content.question: What does the certificate look like?
content.answer: The certificate includes your name, project title, completion date, and a signature from our Loop programming school. You can add it to your CV or LinkedIn profile.

content.question: Can I get a certificate if I'm on the free plan?
content.answer: No. Certificates are only available for users with an active Basic or Premium plan.

content.question: Does the certificate have a unique identification number?
content.answer: Yes, every certificate has a unique ID number that allows verification.

content.question: Are certificates recognized by employers?
content.answer: Certificates prove project completion and practical skills gained. Many users include them in their portfolios or LinkedIn profiles as proof of learning.

content.question: How do I earn points on the platform?
content.answer: You earn points by completing stages and entire projects.

content.question: What are points used for?
content.answer: Points show your progress and engagement with projects.

content.question: Do points affect the certificate?
content.answer: No. You receive a certificate after completing the entire project, regardless of how many points you've earned. Points are proof of active learning.

content.question: Can I lose points I've earned?
content.answer: No, points earned during your work stay on your account and do not expire.

content.question: Where can I check my points?
content.answer: Your current points total is visible on your dashboard.

content.question: What plans are available on the platform?
content.answer: We offer three subscription plans: Free, Basic, and Premium. Each plan provides different levels of access to projects, features, and mentor support.

content.question: What is the difference between monthly and yearly plans?
content.answer: All plans are available as monthly or yearly subscriptions. The yearly plan offers a lower price per month compared to the monthly option.

content.question: In which currencies can I pay?
content.answer: You can pay in four currencies: PLN, EUR, GBP, and USD. The platform automatically adjusts prices based on your selected currency.

content.question: What are the main differences between plans?
content.answer: The plans differ in access to projects, AI chat tokens, the number of 1:1 consultations, and available features. For example, Premium users get access to all projects, more AI chat tokens, and more 1:1 consultations with mentors.

content.question: How does the AI chat work?
content.answer: While working on a project, you can use AI chat to ask for help, explanations, or hints. Each plan includes a different monthly token limit for AI interactions.

content.question: How many projects can I access in each plan?
content.answer: Free users can try selected introductory projects. Basic users unlock more projects, while Premium users have access to all available projects on the platform.

content.question: How can I pay for the subscription?
content.answer: You can pay for the subscription using a credit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express) or other payment methods available through Stripe, such as Apple Pay or Google Pay. All payments are securely processed by Stripe.

content.question: Are my card details safe?
content.answer: Yes. Stripe is fully PCI DSS compliant, which means your data is protected. We do not store card numbers or CVV codes on our servers.

content.question: How does automatic subscription renewal work?
content.answer: Subscriptions automatically renew on a set cycle (monthly or yearly). Stripe will automatically charge your card on the renewal date.

content.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
content.answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account. After cancellation, access to paid features remains until the end of the paid period.

content.question: What happens if my payment fails?
content.answer: Stripe will attempt to charge your card several times. Meanwhile, you will receive an email notification about the payment issue. You can then update your card details or use another payment method.

content.question: Can I change my payment method?
content.answer: Yes. You can add a new card or select another payment method at any time in your account settings.

content.question: Can I change my subscription plan?
content.answer: Yes. You can change your subscription plan (e.g., from monthly to yearly) in the user panel. Stripe will automatically adjust the payment difference.

content.question: Will I receive an invoice or receipt?
content.answer: Yes. After each payment, you will receive an invoice by email and can also download it from your user panel.

content.question: Who can help me with payment issues?
content.answer: If you encounter any issues, you can contact our customer support at info@loop.edu.pl or via the contact form.

content.question: Can I use a trial period?
content.answer: Yes. We offer a 7-day trial on the paid plan. During this period, you can use all subscription features without any charges. After 7 days, the subscription automatically switches to the full paid plan unless canceled.
